errors.text_span: ranging from 64 to 256 on a linear scale
errors.evidence: The x-axis is not on a linear scale, as the spacing between the tick labels is not proportional to the difference in their values. It is a categorical axis with numeric labels.
The value for the MoHD model at 64 sub-dims is approximately 10.45, not 10.4. The value of 10.4 corresponds to the first data point on the far left, not the point at 64 sub-dims.
The value for the MoHD model at 256 sub-dims is approximately 10.6, which is a decrease from the previous point at 128 sub-dims. The value 10.7 is an overestimation.
